div.l: There was no soch from hulle in to Cartage
Hardy he was and wyse I vndretake
With many a tempest he hade his berde shake
He knewe all the havens as they were
Fro Gutlond to the Cape de fenistre
And eủery cryke fro bretaigne in to speyn
His barge was called the Maudeleyn
Wyth vs þere was a doctour of phisyke
In all this world was none hīn lyke
To speke of phesyk and of surgery
For he was grounded in Astronomy
He kept his pacience a full grete dele
In houres by his magyk naturele
Wele koude he fortunen the accident
Of his ymages for by his pacient
He knewe the cause of eủery maladye
Whether it were colde hote moist or drye
And whereof it engendred and of what humour
He was a verray ꝑperfit practysour
The cause / he knew and of his harme þe rote
Anone he yaf þe sekeman his bote
Full redy hade he all his appoticaryes
To sende hīm dragges and his lectuaries
For ech of hem made other for to wynne
Her frenship was nat newe for to begynne
Wele knew he the olde esculapius
And deiscorydes and eke rusus
Olde ypocras and galyen
Serapyou razis and auyzen
Auuerroys dasmacien and costantyn
Bernard gatisden and gilbertyn
Of his diete mesurable was he
For he was of no suꝑperfluite
But of grete norishyng and digestible
His stody was but litle in the bible
In sangwyn and in pers clad wᵗith all
Lyned wᵗith taffata and sendall
And yit he was but esy of dispence
For he kept þat he wan in þe pestilence
For gold in phesyk is accordyall
